# Winter Shipyard Shift Change

Source Notes:
At first light, welders and riggers crossed the shipyard gantry in thick canvas jackets, with metal lunch pails knocking softly against railing posts. Frost held along the painted catwalk edges while diesel haze drifted low between cranes.

Key Observations:
Flood lamps remained active after dawn and threw hard reflections across wet steel decking. Boots tracked slush and rust water into shallow puddles near the loading hooks, and workers moved in compact groups to avoid the wind corridor.

Reusable Concepts:
hard flood-lamp reflections on wet steel
compact worker movement in cold wind
diesel haze under industrial cranes

Uncertainties / Contradictions:
Some notes describe the yard as sharply lit and active, while others suggest a quieter handoff before the full day shift arrived.
